text:
mike: Heads up — after landing kernel-picker tweak (favoring fused attention kernel for short sequences) I'm seeing KV cache grow steadily on longctx tests on H100. PT entries increase but evict doesn't reclaim. Snapshot attached.

anya: can you paste the repro command + perf snapshot? which commit?

mike: commit 4f9a2b7, ran longctx load test: `./bench longctx --model vicuna-13b --len 32k --iter 50` logs:
```
[2026-03-15 14:12:03] kvcache: alloc_slot tag=0x9f3b index=41234
[2026-03-15 14:12:03] pagetable: pte_refcount spike idx=41234 ref=257
[2026-03-15 14:12:12] evict: queued idx=41234 owner=GPU0
[2026-03-15 14:12:15] evict: completed idx=41234 but pte still mapped
```

kevin: interesting — we changed kernel choice path that also flips page-size hint. Could be PT shadow not syncing on copy_to_host path. Did you see nvlink stalls?

mike: yes, nvlink txq grows right before pte spike. Happens on H100 and intermittently on A100 in multi-GPU.

infra-bot: deploy/ci  #1234 promoted commit 4f9a2b7 to staging

lucy: try enabling the legacy page-sync opt (KV_PAGE_SYNC=1) and retest, that toggles the async copy path. also run `perf record -e r815,count` to capture PCIe / NVLink drops.

mike: repro with KV_PAGE_SYNC=1 reduced growth but still saw fragmentation. adding trace shows kernel selection path sometimes tags slot with `small_tile` then later used as `large_tile` — tag mismatch causing reuse lookup miss.

anya: could be tag parity bug between allocator and pager. please capture kvcache metadata dump (`kvcache dump --verbose`) and upload.

kevin: quick workaround PR: gate kernel-picker so tag size is promoted before slot assignment. I'll open PR and run bisect across kernels.

mike: assigning to kevin/lucy. timeline: if workaround fixes staging by EOD we can roll to prod. :thumbsup:

lucy: also put a telemetry counter for `pt_tag_mismatch` and `evict_no_effect` so we don't blind-ship.

mike: added to checklist. thanks.
